topic: Calling a Cooking Hotline for a Substitute

script.title: BUTTERMILK HELP
script.scene_zh: 烹飪專線 · 烘焙救援
script.story_hook: A boy calls a cooking hotline for one missing cup.
script.intro_zh: 一個男孩打進烹飪專線，只為缺的那一杯。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a cooking hotline saves biscuits. Listen for substitutions and amounts.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一通烹飪專線救了餅乾。留意替代品與份量的說法。
script.outro: Golden biscuits, one happy grandma. Yum!
script.outro_zh: 金黃的餅乾出爐，阿嬤開心了。嗯！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the hotline's substitution lines.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀專線裡的替代說法。
script.char_a_description: a friendly woman in her forties with dark brown hair in a neat braid, wearing a mustard yellow apron over a white shirt, round reading glasses on a chain, warm smile
script.char_b_description: a teenage boy with messy chestnut curls, wearing a red checked shirt over a plain tee, blue jeans with flour on the knees, canvas sneakers, eager face

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooking line, this is Beth. Ask away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkɪŋ laɪn ðɪs ɪz bɛθ æsk əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 烹飪專線，我是貝絲，請說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi Beth! It's Sam. Total biscuit disaster.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ bɛθ ɪts sæm ˈtoʊtəl ˈbɪskɪt dɪˈzæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨貝絲！我是山姆，遇到比司吉大悲劇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds serious. What's missing exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈsɪɹiəs wʌts ˈmɪsɪŋ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很嚴重。到底少了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buttermilk. The recipe needs two whole cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtɚˌmɪlk ðə ˈɹɛsəpə nidz tu hoʊl kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 白脫牛奶。食譜要整整兩杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, don't toss the flour yet, Sam.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ doʊnt tɔs ðə ˈflaʊɚ jɛt sæm/
dialogue.zh: 先別急著倒掉麵粉，山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank goodness. Regular milk—um, I have some.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ mɪlk ʌm aɪ hæv sʌm/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地。普通牛奶嘛，呃，我還有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll fix that. Do you have a lemon?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil fɪks ðæt du ju hæv ə ˈlɛmən/
dialogue.zh: 有解。你有一顆檸檬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half, maybe. There's one in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ˈmeɪbi ðɛɹz wʌn ɪn ðə fɹɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 大概半顆。冰箱裡有一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squeeze it into a cup, see that?
dialogue.phonetic: /skwiz ɪt ˈɪntu ə kʌp si ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 把它擠進量杯，看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one splash of juice. That's it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn slæʃ əv dʒus ðæts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就這麼一點果汁？這樣就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tablespoon, then fill the cup with milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈteɪˌblspun ðɛn fɪl ðə kʌp wɪθ mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 一湯匙果汁，再把杯子補滿牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, so two spoons of lemon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps soʊ tu spunz ʌv ˈlɛmən/
dialogue.zh: 食譜要兩杯，所以要兩匙檸檬汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Now, wait five minutes. That's key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli naʊ weɪt faɪv ˈmɪnəts ðæts ki/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確。接著等五分鐘，這步很關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks… curdled. Did I ruin it already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks ˈkɜɹdəld dɪd aɪ ˈɹuɪn ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 它看起來……結塊了。我是不是已經弄砸了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, no, that's the magic. Truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ noʊ ðæts ðə ˈmædʒɪk ˈtɹulɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不不，這才是魔法。真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Curdled milk becomes buttermilk? Fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɜɹdəld mɪlk bɪˈkʌmz ˈbʌtɚˌmɪlk fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 結塊的牛奶變成白脫牛奶？真好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost. Now, is your dough already mixed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst naʊ ɪz jʊɹ doʊ ɔlˈrɛdi mɪkst/
dialogue.zh: 差不多。你的麵糊已經拌好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat as a pancake, sad, in the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt æz ə ˈpænˌkeɪk sæd ɪn ðə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 扁扁一坨在盆裡，好可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll lift it. Lemon first, follow me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil lɪft ɪt ˈlɛmən fɜɹst ˈfɑloʊ mi/
dialogue.zh: 我們會讓它膨起來。先做檸檬牛奶，跟著我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five sleepy minutes. Okay, it's thickening.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈslipi ˈmɪnəts oʊˈkeɪ ɪts ˈθɪkənɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 讓它睡五分鐘。好，它變稠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell the lemon yet? That's buttermilk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ðə ˈlɛmən jɛt ðæts ˈbʌtɚˌmɪlk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聞到檸檬味了嗎？這就變成白脫牛奶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What makes it rise? Soda or powder?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt meɪks ɪt ɹaɪz ˈsoʊdə ɔɹ ˈpaʊdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 什麼讓它膨起來？小蘇打還是泡打粉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soda. One spoon, mixed into the flour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊdə wʌn spun mɪkst ˈɪntu ðə ˈflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 小蘇打。一匙，先拌進乾粉裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got soda, but it's buried somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ˈsoʊdə bʌt ɪts ˈbɛɹid ˈsʌmwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我有小蘇打，只是藏得深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check under the flour, classic hiding spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈflaʊɚ ˈklæsɪk ˈhaɪdɪŋ spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 到麵粉罐下面找找，經典躲藏點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the flour! Found it, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈflaʊɚ faʊnd ɪt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 真的在麵粉下面！找到了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One level spoon, stir it into the flour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈlɛvəl spun stɜɹ ɪt ˈɪntu ðə ˈflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 取平平一匙，拌進麵粉裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level means no heap on top, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl minz noʊ hip ɑn tɑp ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 平平的意思是不能堆成小山，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Flat as the spoon's back. Nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs flæt æz ðə spunz bæk naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對！像勺背一樣平。很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big bowl. Sift or dump straight in?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ boʊl sɪft ɔɹ dʌmp stɹeɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 用大碗。要過篩還是直接倒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sift it so it fluffs up nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪft ɪt soʊ ɪt flʌfs ʌp ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 過篩吧，粉會變得鬆鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No sifter. Can I just shake well?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈsɪftɚ kæn aɪ dʒʌst ʃeɪk wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 沒有篩子。我慢慢抖動可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow stream, high hand, it works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ stɹim haɪ hænd ɪt wɜɹks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 細細地倒、手舉高一點，效果不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like snow falling? Okay—done, no mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk snoʊ ˈfɔlɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ dʌn noʊ mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 像下雪一樣？好——完成了，沒弄髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now pour in the milk mix, stir once.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ pɔɹ ɪn ðə mɪlk mɪks stɜɹ wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 現在把檸檬牛奶倒進去，攪一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mixing… the dough is sticky, super sticky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪksɪŋ ðə doʊ ɪz ˈstɪki ˈsupɚ ˈstɪki/
dialogue.zh: 攪拌中……麵糊好黏，黏到不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticky is correct. Trust it, don't fight it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki ɪz kəˈɹɛkt tɹʌst ɪt doʊnt faɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 黏才是對的。相信它，別跟它對抗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That could be life advice, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kʊd bi laɪf ædˈvaɪs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 這根本是人生道理耶，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Oven at four-two-five, ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈʌvən æt ˈfɔɹ tu faɪv tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 哈！烤箱設四二五度，十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the oven—oh, a pan mishap!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə ˈʌvən oʊ ə pæn ˈmɪʃæp/
dialogue.zh: 進烤箱了——噢，烤盤出了小意外！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happened? Talk to me, Sam.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənd tɔk tə mi sæm/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？跟我說說，山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half my dough escaped onto the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf maɪ doʊ ɪˈskæpt ˈɑn tu ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一半的麵糊趁亂逃到烤盤上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's normal. Bake it flat, it's rustic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnɔɹməl beɪk ɪt flæt ɪts ˈɹʌstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那很正常。就地烤平，那叫鄉村風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rustic! I love that word. So, saved?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹʌstɪk aɪ lʌv ðæt wɜɹd soʊ seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 鄉村風！我愛這個詞。所以還有救嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Totally saved. Rustic biscuits are a style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli seɪvd ˈɹʌstɪk ˈbɪskɪts ɑɹ ə staɪl/
dialogue.zh: 完全有救。鄉村風餅乾本來就是一種風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes… oh, they're actually rising.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts oʊ ðɛɹ ˈæktʃuəli ˈɹaɪzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘了……噢，它們真的在膨起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can almost smell it from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈɔlmoʊst smɛl ɪt fɹʌm hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我隔著電話都快聞到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma says God laughs when adults bake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹæmə sɛz ɡɑd læfz wɛn əˈdʌlts beɪk/
dialogue.zh: 阿嬤說過，大人烤餅乾的時候，老天覺得最好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, but He probably takes notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt hi ˈpɹɑbəbli teɪks noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 說不定他還在一旁做筆記呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're the reason biscuits exist tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ðə ˈɹizən ˈbɪskɪts ɪɡˈzɪst təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚的餅乾能存在，都是因為你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just draw the map, you bake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dʒʌst dɹɔ ðə mæp ju beɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我只是畫地圖，實際動手烤的是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll call it team baking, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil kɔl ɪt tim ˈbeɪkɪŋ dil/
dialogue.zh: 那我們這叫「團隊烘焙」，好不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. How's it looking now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil haʊz ɪt lʊkɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。現在情況看起來怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Golden tops, smell—oh, the whole house smells.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡoʊldən tɑps smɛl oʊ ðə hoʊl haʊz smɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 表面金黃，那個香味——天啊，全屋都是香的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music to a hotline. Pull them out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmjuzɪk tə ə ˈhɑˌlaɪn pʊl ðɛm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 對熱線來說這是天籟。快出爐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tray is hot—oven mitt—there we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪ ɪz hɑt ˈʌvən mɪt ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 烤盤好燙——隔熱手套——好，出爐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes rest, then serve them warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɹɛst ðɛn sɜɹv ðɛm wɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 靜置十分鐘，然後趁熱端上桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First one goes to Grandma, no argument.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst wʌn ɡoʊz tə ˈɡɹæmə noʊ ˈɑɹɡjəmənt/
dialogue.zh: 第一塊一定要給阿嬤，不用爭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a good kid. Dinner is saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə ɡʊd kɪd ˈdɪnɚ ɪz seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 你是個心裡有家人的孩子。晚餐得救了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Beth. Good night from biscuit heaven.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk juː bɛθ ɡʊd naɪt fɹʌm ˈbɪskɪt ˈhɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 真的謝謝你，貝絲。餅乾天堂祝你晚安。

script.youtube_title_en: "That's Buttermilk Now" — Calling a Cooking Hotline for a Substitute
script.youtube_description:
食譜要兩杯白脫牛奶，家裡卻只有半顆檸檬，怎麼辦？這一集用60句自然英文，重現一通熱騰騰的烹飪專線：一匙檸檬汁加牛奶補滿量杯、靜置五分鐘結塊成替身、小蘇打埋在麵粉罐下、平平一匙的正確量法，還有麵糊逃到烤盤上的意外如何變成鄉村風。

你會聽到：
- 替代做法：「One tablespoon, then fill the cup with milk.」
- 關鍵等待：「Now, wait five minutes. That's key.」
- 份量確認：「Level means no heap on top, right?」
- 烤箱指示：「Oven at four-two-five, ten minutes.」

這些說法涵蓋了怎麼問比例、怎麼確認步驟、怎麼把失誤救回來。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽完整段對話，再一句一句模仿，讓句子變成口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你的每一次烘焙，都有香香金黃的結局。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
The recipe wants two cups of buttermilk, and your kitchen has... half a lemon. In 60 short A2 lines, a teenage baker calls a cooking hotline and learns the classic fix: one tablespoon of lemon juice, milk up to the line, five quiet minutes. Then come the soda hunt, level spoon measures, a sifting trick without a sifter, and batter escaping onto the tray before a rustic rescue.

You'll hear how-to instructions, amounts and ratios in plain English, phone small talk, and a warm goodbye, all in natural American speech with contractions and fillers. The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice, so every kitchen phrase sticks without memorizing.

Made for A2 learners who love cooking videos and easy baking English.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
白脫牛奶用完了，晚餐的餅乾還烤不烤？別掛電話，熱線有解。

這一集帶大家走進一通溫暖的烹飪專線：從檸檬加牛奶做出替代液、找回埋在麵粉下的小蘇打，到平平一匙的量法與烤箱溫度，最後把麵糊逃跑的意外變成鄉村風餅乾。

你會聽到：
🍋 替代做法：「One tablespoon, then fill the cup with milk.」
⏰ 關鍵等待：「Exactly. Now, wait five minutes. That's key.」
🥄 份量確認：「Level means no heap on top, right?」
🔥 烤箱指示：「Oven at four-two-five, ten minutes.」

這一集也示範怎麼描述意外、怎麼接住對方的安慰——失手也能變成風格。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
